name: osm-static-maps
role: Raster map still with GeoJSON overlay from any tile server, via Leaflet in headless Chromium
summary: osm-static-maps renders a Leaflet map in headless Chromium and returns a PNG with GeoJSON, markers and attribution over raster tiles. Its default tile source is OpenStreetMap, whose tile policy forbids headless automated use, so in VCR use it with a tile server you own or are licensed to use.
use_when: A raster map plate with a GeoJSON overlay when you have a licensed or self-hosted {z}/{x}/{y} tile server
Over maplibre-native or chiitiler when no vector style should be built
avoid_when: OSM tiles: its policy forbids headless fetching and needs an identifying User-Agent
Vector styles or camera motion: chiitiler or maplibre-native
Vector data cleanup before drawing: mapshaper
notes: 2026-11-27: Lead said Chromium needed and live OSM tiles; install line confirmed. OSM tile policy (checked 2026-11-27) requires a distinct User-Agent and Referer and forbids offline, bulk and headless pan/zoom fetching; the tool's default Chromium User-Agent does not satisfy it, so the fixture uses a loopback tile server and never contacts OSM.
2026-11-27: typings declare default.closeBrowser(); at runtime it is a named export closeBrowser. Without calling it a Node script never exits.

evidence.result: GeoJSON polygon over synthetic loopback tiles, Chrome for Testing 1208 via PUPPETEER_EXECUTABLE_PATH, Node 22.19.0; 640x360 PNG, 6 local tile requests, 4 pixel probes exact, reruns byte-identical; first attribution threshold was wrong and was corrected after inspection.
evidence.scope: Library only, loopback synthetic tiles, one polygon and attribution, macOS arm64. Not OSM tiles, policy-compliant OSM use, markers, polylines, vector server, CLI or server.

assessment.rationale: npm 5.0.0 published 2026-06-25, GPL-2.0-only, pushed 2026-10-22. Works with any raster tile URL; default OSM source conflicts with the OSM tile policy for headless use, so keep for owned or licensed tiles only. Overlaps chiitiler for stills but needs no style.
